subject: Closure choreography & sign-off timetable for StellarRetail POC — final gating and e-sign lanes
messages:
From: Ari Gupta <ari.gupta@stellarretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@stellarretail.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Final timetable & signers for Redwood POC close

Marissa —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement and I reviewed the MAP you shared; we want to lock the final go/no-go and signing window this week. A few questions before we move DocuSign:

- Who will be the Redwood signers (legal vs sales acceptance)?
- Any hard blackout windows for our start date (we're planning a merchandising push on 12/08)?
- Can you attach the latest evaluation results and a simple checklist we can hand to our legal team?

Tanya from procurement is copied — she will coordinate PO timing once signers are confirmed. Looking to start POC ramp the week of 12/15 if we can get signatures by 12/05.

Appreciate a quick call if useful.

—Ari
Ari Gupta
Head of Retail Platforms, StellarRetail
ari.gupta@stellarretail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ari Gupta <ari.gupta@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@stellarretail.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Final timetable & signers for Redwood POC close

Ari — thanks, and good questions. Attaching the MAP v3 and the evaluation summary (spreadsheet) for legal and procurement. Quick answers below; details in attachments.

- Redwood signers: Standard practice is Sales (me) to execute the MAP/Commercial terms + Legal (Ben) to countersign the Master Services Agreement. We can route DocuSign to Sales -> Legal -> Customer signers.
- Start date blackout: noted 12/08 merchandising push; recommend we avoid any rollout during that week. Proposed day-one (soft) is 12/16 with a 2-week ramp.
- Checklist: included in MAP v3 (front page) and I added a short acceptance checklist in the Evaluation_Summary.xlsx.

Asks for you/Procurement: please confirm the customer signers (names & emails) and whether your legal needs a separate redline pass before DocuSign. If you confirm signers today, we can prepare an envelope and target signatures by 12/04–12/05.

Attachments: Stellar_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP with milestones and acceptance), Evaluation_Summary.xlsx (pass/fail and open items), Signer_Roles.csv (template)

If helpful, I can run a 20-min wrap call at 11:30 PST to walk signers & timeline.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(650) 555-0142

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ari Gupta <ari.gupta@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Final timetable & signers for Redwood POC close

Ari / Marissa —

I reviewed the MAP and evaluation summary. Two quick legal items:

1) Standard SOW + MSA flow is fine. If StellarRetail needs custom data-residency language, flag now — that will add a turnaround (typically 3 business days).
2) Signer sequencing: Sales -> Legal (Redwood) -> Customer Exec -> Customer Procurement. For DocuSign routing, Ben (legal) will need to be a required signer to countersign.

Proposed sign windows to keep your 12/16 ramp:
- Prepare envelope by 12/01
- Customer signers receive envelope 12/02 (24–48hr turnaround requested)
- Redwood legal countersign 12/04–12/05

If procurement needs a redline pass, send over edits by EOD Thursday (11/20) so we can keep to the timeframe. Otherwise I approve routing as above.

Ben Carter
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Ari Gupta <ari.gupta@stellarretail.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Final timetable & signers for Redwood POC close

Team / Ari —

Product/CS checklist sanity check: we are clear on the acceptance criteria in the MAP (throughput, latency under 350ms p50 on standard queries, embedding accuracy thresholds). A couple operational prerequisites before day-one:

- Customer provisioning: API keys + VPC peering (if required) to be completed by 12/12. Rohan will own the peering window.
- Test corpus: we need the final 10k prompt set and 3 priority evaluation prompts by 12/05 to validate runbook.
- Monitoring: enable token-level reporting and a dashboard snapshot for your team by 12/15.

If those items are met, we can safely do the soft start 12/16. If any slip, propose a contingency start 12/22.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ari Gupta <ari.gupta@stellarretail.com>, Procurement <procure@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Final timetable & signers for Redwood POC close — docs & next steps

Ari / Tanya / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Per Ben's note, we will prepare the DocuSign envelope today and route Sales -> Ben (legal) -> Ari (exec) -> Procurement signer. I am including the DocuSign prep link and the current HubSpot deal below for reference.

DocuSign (prep): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

Action items and owners:
- Procurement (Tanya): confirm final signer name/email by EOD 11/21 (Signer_Roles.csv attached).
- Stellar: deliver 10k prompt corpus + 3 priority eval prompts by 12/05 (for Laura/Rohan).
- Redwood (Marissa): prepare envelope 11/20, target customer delivery 12/02; Ben to countersign by 12/05.

Proposed soft start: 12/16. Contingency: 12/22 if any upstream items miss their dates.

If everyone confirms signers and no redlines arrive by EOD 11/21, we will proceed with the envelope and expect signatures in the 12/02–12/05 window.

Looking forward to getting this over the line. Quick sync call tomorrow at 11:30 PST if anyone wants to walk through the envelope.

Best —

Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: Stellar_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP), Evaluation_Summary.xlsx (results), Signer_Roles.csv (signer template)
